notes.title: Level Editor Update!
notes.content:
The level editor for Midnight Arrow Is here! Not much to say because with the editor you can make your own level and using it you can basically do everything that is in the game (except NPC quests, but I might add that later if I get some nice feedback 💪)

There is also a new type of arrow that was never used in the game 👀

If you want to learn how to use it, I made a tutorial for it so go check it out!

https://youtu.be/Q1lfglr0fGk
